_about: XEREFT visual signature for plan sheets (C-300): ONE look for every project - same fonts, sizes, colours, leader geometry and alignment grid. Read by c300-road-labels.mjs (placement) and visual-lint.mjs (checks). User brief 2026-10-25: 'always the same signature: colours, font, sizes; labels and arrows tidy, aligned vertically and horizontally, never overlapped, professional'. Extend it when the user corrects a sheet: add the rule here, add a lesson in references/visual-lessons.json, make visual-lint.mjs check it.

typography.survey: keep the surveyor's text exactly as drawn (never re-style survey text)

ourLabels.note: native NoteLabels (EOP, RW) take size/font from their Civil 3D label styles on C-ANNO; never override

typography.titles: lot notes / street names keep the survey fonts, centred in their lot or street, one row per sheet row

colour.ourLabels: colour 8 (grey) on C-ANNO: the monochrome plot prints them black; no per-label colour overrides
colour.onScreen: cyan = R/W lot line only, white = street names and symbols, yellow = architecture, grey = the rest (see memory fase1-look-and-tools)

leaders.geometry: EOP / EXIST R/W / SAN MH labels: strictly vertical or strictly horizontal in SHEET axes (never diagonal). Utility callouts and ALIGNMENT START/END may be one straight diagonal leader when the orthogonal one would cross something (see diagonalExceptions)
leaders.textSide: text right of a vertical leader (sideFt) so every label attaches on the same side; left only when the right side would sit on survey linework or text
leaders.arrow: one arrowhead per label, at the feature (edge, R/W line, structure); never two labels pointing at the same spot

appliesTo: multi-line utility callouts (EXIST 8" G.V., SAN MAIN, WM... MLeaders)
diagonalExceptions.why: user 2026-10-25: these point at a symbol or a station inside a crowded block; a strictly vertical/horizontal leader would cross linework or text, so a straight DIAGONAL leader is the tidy choice
rules: exception only when the orthogonal leader would cross survey linework / other text or the text would not fit beside the arrow
ONE straight segment, no bends, one arrowhead (or dot) at the feature, never two leaders to the same spot

text block sits in clear space, left-aligned, same style/size/colour as every other label (Formtech-1.0, 1.4 ft, C-ANNO, 8); leader enters the block at its first line or its left middle, never across the text
leader must not cross another label's text or leader; angles within one sheet stay in one family (prefer 45 deg +- 15, or the street-normal direction)
keep leaders as short as the free space allows; the text may move, the arrow tip never does

grid.rows: labels of the same kind on the same side of the street share ONE text line (arrows within snapFt along the push axis): a row of EOP or EXIST R/W reads as a straight row
grid.noOverlap: label text never sits on survey linework (lot lines, edges, centrelines) nor on other text; boxes are tested before placement (c300-road-labels.mjs) and again by visual-lint.mjs / fase1-qc.py on the plot
grid.lotNotes: survey lot notes centred between lot lines, X = X0 - 0.036878*(Y - Y0) for one sheet row, next row = row + half the tallest block + 4 ft (topo-move-text.mjs)
grid.sanMhLabels: text right of the arrow, left-aligned lines, near-vertical leader (anchor = arrow + (-40, +2) in model for the FormTech twist), rotation in RADIANS (topo-san-mh-labels.mjs)

nativeLabels._about: Design engineer correction 2026-10-27 (video review of Seidenstein PROPOSED). Applies to PROPOSED / design sheets; see references/engineer-feedback-2026-10.md section 1.
nativeLabels.rule: every plan callout that carries a station/offset or an elevation is a NATIVE Civil 3D label bound to its alignment / profile view, never an MLeader or MText copy: it must update when moved. Our MLeader signature (Formtech-1.0, C-ANNO, grey 8) stays only for annotations that carry NO model data (R/W marks, EOP when not native, notes, SAN MH callouts, utility callouts of Fase 1).

planCallouts.command: Annotate > Add Labels > Alignment > Station Offset - Fixed Point
planCallouts.typedByHand: only the INV line (and any fixed wording the style does not carry); STA/OFF stay automatic
planCallouts.editWith: contextual tab Edit Label Text (EditLabelText) -> Text Component Editor; Reset Label restores the style text
planCallouts.leaderBehaviour: arrow tip = control point (station follows the tip); several labels that meet at one crossing keep their tips on that crossing, only the text is moved

profileLabels.elevation: Add Labels > Profile View > Station Elevation, style 'Station and Elevation', marker '_No Markers'
profileLabels.pipe: native Pipe Profile Label (pipe label style 'Prop San Main'; invert through the End Depth to Invert property)
profileLabels.crossing: no automatic label exists for the crossing point of another pipe: manual (MLeader) is accepted there

forbidden: explode or convert a native label to MLeader/MText to hide the override glyph or to edit its text
re-setting a viewport / annotation scale to make a label fit
deleting the (yellow) labels a Civil 3D table reads: switch their layer to no-plot instead
nativeLabels.overrideGlyph: the orange circled 'i' only marks overridden label text; it never plots. Do not replace labels because of it; use LABELOVERRIDEGLYPHS 0 for the live window (per PC setting, not stored in the DWG)
nativeLabels.baseException: Fase 1 BASE keeps the user's 2026-10-26 decision (ALGN START/END replaced by MLeaders so the receiving engineer sees no glyph). Ask the engineer once whether he prefers native + LABELOVERRIDEGLYPHS 0 in the hand-off notes.

viewports.rule: viewport scale = annotation scale (C-300 plan 1"=20', annotation scale shown in the status bar); never change it to fit content; lock the viewports after setting them; profile sheets keep their own viewport scale (0.05 / 1:20 vertical exaggeration view style V:10)

rwMarks.rule: white `R/W` MLeader per station: strictly orthogonal leader in SHEET axes, 8 ft long, text beyond the landing (right of a vertical leader); same family as EOP / EXIST R/W
rwMarks.stations: 14 ft from each R/W corner on every leg, then equally spaced (~125 ft) along every R/W run, survey lines and extension lines alike
rwMarks.blocked: retry street side, 11/15 ft, tighter clearance, slide <=20 ft (corner stations <=60 ft into the run); omit only without room; never overlap texts, dimensions or lines; a mark touching the sheet frame must lie entirely inside it
rwMarks.landingCalibration: Formtech-1.0: landing end = text point +/-(h+0.1) ft inboard and h/2 below the text point
